title: Novena to Our Lady of Lourdes
description: A nine-day prayer to Our Lady of Lourdes, seeking her powerful intercession for healing, conversion, and spiritual renewal. This devotion centers on the miraculous apparitions at Lourdes, France, where Mary appeared to Saint Bernadette Soubirous in 1858 and where countless healings continue to occur.
intention: For physical and spiritual healing, reconciliation, conversion of sinners, strength for the chronically ill, and Mary's intercession before her Son Jesus the Divine Physician
instructions: Pray this novena for 9 consecutive days, especially when seeking healing for yourself or others, praying for conversion, or preparing for the feast of Our Lady of Lourdes on February 11. This novena is particularly powerful for those who are sick, caregivers, healthcare workers, and anyone desiring spiritual healing from past wounds, addictions, or sins. Our Lady of Lourdes is especially invoked for impossible causes and those who have lost hope.
background_info: In 1858, the Blessed Virgin Mary appeared eighteen times to Bernadette Soubirous, a poor and uneducated 14-year-old girl in Lourdes, France. During the apparitions, Mary identified herself as 'The Immaculate Conception,' confirming the dogma proclaimed by Pope Pius IX four years earlier. A spring miraculously appeared at the grotto when Bernadette dug at Mary's instructions. Since then, Lourdes has become one of the world's greatest pilgrimage sites, with over 7,000 documented unexplained healings, 70 of which have been officially declared miraculous by the Church. The waters of Lourdes continue to draw millions of pilgrims seeking healing each year.

days.title: Day 1: The Immaculate Conception
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Virgin of Lourdes, when you appeared to Bernadette, you proclaimed yourself 'The Immaculate Conception,' confirming the Church's teaching that you were conceived without original sin. Your immaculate purity was the perfect preparation for you to become the Mother of God, a pure vessel to receive the Word made flesh. I marvel at this privilege given to you by God and I ask for your help in my struggle against sin. Though I was born with original sin and have committed many personal sins, I long for the purity that you possessed from the first moment of your existence. Help me to turn away from sin and toward God. When I am tempted to impurity of thought, word, or deed, remind me that my body is a temple of the Holy Spirit. When I struggle with sinful habits, intercede for me that I may receive the grace to overcome them. Wash my soul in the healing waters of your Son's mercy and help me to grow in holiness. O Immaculate Virgin, obtain for me the grace of a pure heart, that I may see God more clearly and love Him more fully. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us.

O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: Mary's proclamation as 'The Immaculate Conception' at Lourdes confirmed Pope Pius IX's dogmatic definition of 1854. Her sinlessness from conception prepared her to be the perfect vessel for the Incarnation, and her intercession helps us grow in purity and holiness.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Mary, obtain for me the grace of purity of heart, mind, and body. Help me to turn away from sin and to grow in holiness.
days.scripture: "He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David, and he will reign over Jacob's descendants forever; his kingdom will never end." - Luke 1:32-33

days.title: Day 2: Healing of the Sick
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Lourdes, countless pilgrims have journeyed to your grotto seeking healing, and thousands have returned home with extraordinary healings that medical science cannot explain. I come to you today, whether physically present at Lourdes or spiritually united with its pilgrims, bringing my own illnesses and those of people I love. You know the suffering that sickness brings - the pain, the fear, the exhaustion, the isolation, and sometimes the despair. Watch over all who are ill, especially those for whom I now pray [mention specific names and illnesses]. Intercede with your Son Jesus, the Divine Physician, that He may grant healing according to His perfect will. I know that not everyone receives physical healing at Lourdes - sometimes the healing that is needed is spiritual or emotional rather than physical. But I trust that every sincere prayer is heard and answered in the way that is best for each person's salvation. Help those who are sick to bear their illness with patience and faith, uniting their suffering with Christ's. Give strength to those who care for them - family members, doctors, nurses, and all healthcare workers. O Mother of Lourdes, bring your healing touch to all who suffer. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us.

O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: Lourdes has become synonymous with healing, with thousands of documented healings and 70 officially declared miracles. Yet every pilgrim receives some form of healing - whether physical, spiritual, or emotional - as Mary intercedes with her Son for all who come to her with faith.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Lourdes, I entrust to you all who are sick, especially [mention names]. Pray to your Son Jesus for healing according to His holy will.
days.scripture: "Great crowds came to him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute and many others, and laid them at his feet; and he healed them." - Matthew 15:30

days.title: Day 3: The Message of Reconciliation
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Lourdes, during your apparitions you instructed Bernadette to 'Penance! Penance! Penance!' and to pray for sinners and for the conversion of the world. Your message reminds us that healing must go beyond the physical to address the deeper wounds of sin that separate us from God and from each other. I examine my conscience before you today, asking for the grace to see my sins clearly and to repent sincerely. Too often I have neglected God's commandments or followed my own will instead of His. I have hurt others through my actions or my failures to act. I have been selfish, proud, impatient, and unloving. Mary, you who are without sin, obtain for me the grace of true sorrow for my sins and the firm purpose of amendment. Lead me to the Sacrament of Reconciliation, where I may experience the healing forgiveness of your Son. Help me to make a good confession, hiding nothing and resolving to change. After confession, help me to avoid the near occasions of sin and to grow in virtue. Pray also for the conversion of sinners throughout the world - for those who have fallen away from the faith, for those caught in serious sin, and for those who do not yet know Christ. May your intercession bring them back to the Father's embrace. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us.

O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: Mary's call to 'Penance!' at Lourdes echoes the Gospel message of repentance. The healing waters of Lourdes are meant not just for physical ailments but for the spiritual healing that comes through reconciliation with God.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Lourdes, obtain for me the grace of true repentance and lead me to experience God's mercy in the Sacrament of Reconciliation.
days.scripture: "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord." - Acts 3:19

days.title: Day 4: The Healing Waters
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Lourdes, at your instruction Bernadette dug in the mud of the grotto, and a spring of clear water miraculously appeared. This spring, which continues to flow today, has been the source of countless healings and is a powerful symbol of the living water that Christ promised to give. Just as water cleanses and refreshes the body, you invite us to spiritual renewal through the waters of Baptism that wash away original sin, the water of God's Word that purifies our hearts, and the water of trust and surrender that opens us to God's grace. Help me to drink deeply from these spiritual streams. When I feel spiritually dry, exhausted, or thirsty for meaning, lead me to the source of living water that never runs dry. Help me to trust that God can do the impossible in my life - just as the waters of Lourdes continue to heal when all human treatments have failed. Wash away my selfishness, my pride, my fears, and my doubts. Purify my intentions and make my heart a clean vessel. May the grace that flows through your intercession refresh my soul and heal my spirit. I also pray for those who are preparing for or remembering their Baptism - may they experience anew the grace of being children of God. O Lady of the Spring, let your healing waters flow in my life. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us.

O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: The spring that appeared at Lourdes symbolizes the living water Jesus promised to the Samaritan woman. This water continues to flow, bringing physical and spiritual healing to pilgrims who bathe in or drink from it with faith.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Lourdes, wash away my sins and renew my soul with the living water that flows from your Son's Sacred Heart.
days.scripture: "But whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life." - John 4:14

days.title: Day 5: Patience in Suffering
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Lourdes, not everyone who comes to your shrine receives physical healing, yet countless pilgrims speak of receiving a different kind of grace - the strength to bear their sufferings with faith and even with joy. You know what it means to suffer, even though you were sinless. You watched your Son die a brutal death on the cross. You understand pain and can teach us how to unite our suffering with His. I bring to you my struggles - the chronic illness that will not go away, the relationship problems that persist despite prayer, the financial difficulties that weigh me down, the loneliness that feels unbearable. Teach me to trust that God has a purpose even in my pain. When I am tempted to despair or to blame God for my difficulties, help me to remember that suffering united to Christ's becomes redemptive. Help me to say with Jesus, 'Not my will but yours be done.' Give me the patience to endure when healing does not come quickly or when it does not come in the form I expected. Help me to find meaning in my suffering by offering it for others - for the conversion of sinners, for the souls in purgatory, for those experiencing similar trials. Transform my impatience into acceptance, my complaints into gratitude, and my despair into hope. O Mother who suffered, teach me to suffer well. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us.

O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: At Lourdes, many receive not the healing they ask for but the grace they need - patience, courage, and peace in suffering. Mary, who stood at the foot of the cross, understands our pain and teaches us to unite our sufferings with Christ's for the salvation of souls.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Lourdes, grant me patience in suffering and the grace to unite my pain with Christ's Passion for the good of souls.
days.scripture: "Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope." - Romans 5:3-4

days.title: Day 6: The Example of Bernadette
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Lourdes, you chose to appear not to the powerful or learned but to a poor, uneducated, sickly girl named Bernadette Soubirous. In choosing her, you showed that God often uses the weak and lowly to accomplish His greatest works. Bernadette's humility, simplicity, and faithfulness teach me how to respond to your presence in my life. Though she was ridiculed, interrogated, and doubted, she remained steadfast in speaking the truth about what she had seen and heard. Though crowds followed her everywhere after the apparitions, she never sought attention or fame. Though she could have used her connection to Lourdes for personal advantage, she instead entered a convent and lived a hidden life of prayer and service. Help me to learn from Bernadette's example. Give me the courage to speak truth even when others mock or doubt me. Help me to remain humble when given positions of honor or recognition. Give me the strength to live my faith consistently in small, hidden ways rather than only in moments of great visibility. Like Bernadette, may I be willing to suffer for what is right without bitterness or complaint. Through her intercession, obtain for me the grace to persevere in faith, hope, and love until the end of my life. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us.

Saint Bernadette, pray for us.
days.reflection: St. Bernadette Soubirous (1844-1879) was canonized in 1933. Her body remains incorrupt to this day, visible in the convent chapel in Nevers, France. Her humble fidelity to Mary's message teaches us that greatness in God's eyes is measured by love and faithfulness, not by worldly success.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Lourdes, through the intercession of St. Bernadette, help me to grow in humility, simplicity, and faithful witness to your Son.
days.scripture: "But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong." - 1 Corinthians 1:27

days.title: Day 7: Prayer and Procession
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Lourdes, one of your requests during the apparitions was for Bernadette to pray the rosary and to walk in procession. These two practices continue at Lourdes today - the constant praying of the rosary and the daily candlelight procession. Through them, you teach us the power of communal prayer and public witness. The rosary is a powerful prayer that you have given to the Church. Through it, we meditate on the mysteries of your Son's life, death, and resurrection while seeking your intercession. Help me to pray the rosary more frequently and more devoutly. When my mind wanders or I feel too busy for this prayer, remind me of the countless graces that flow through it. The procession at Lourdes is a witness to the world - thousands of pilgrims walking together, carrying candles, singing hymns, and praying. It is a public declaration of faith that encourages other believers and witnesses to non-believers. Help me to be willing to give public witness to my faith, even when it might be unpopular or inconvenient. Give me the courage to pray in public, to attend church when attendance is declining, to speak about my faith with others, and to make the sign of the cross in restaurants and other public places. Mary, may my life be a continuous procession toward heaven, with you leading the way. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us.

O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: The candlelight procession at Lourdes, which began during the apparitions themselves, continues each evening with thousands of pilgrims. It represents the Church on pilgrimage toward heaven, with Mary leading her children to the light of Christ.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Lourdes, help me to pray the rosary with devotion and to give witness to my faith in both private and public life.
days.scripture: "For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them." - Matthew 18:20

days.title: Day 8: The Sick and Caregivers
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Lourdes, at your shrine, the sick are given special honor. They are helped to bathe in the waters, they lead the processions, and they are treated as the most important pilgrims. You revealed through this that those who suffer have a special place in God's heart and in the Church. I pray today for all who are sick and for those who care for them. For those who are ill, I ask for courage, patience, and hope. When illness steals independence, dignity, and dreams, be close to them with your motherly comfort. When pain is constant or treatments fail, give them strength to persevere. When death approaches, prepare them to meet your Son with peace rather than fear. For doctors, nurses, and all healthcare workers, I ask for skill, wisdom, and compassion. May they see each patient as a beloved child of God and treat them accordingly. Give them strength when they are exhausted, patience when they are frustrated, and hope when they feel discouraged. Protect them from burnout and help them to find meaning and joy in their vocation. For family members and friends who care for the sick at home, I ask for extra measures of love, patience, and endurance. When caregiving is exhausting and thankless, remind them that in serving the sick, they serve Christ Himself. O Lady of the Sick, watch over all who suffer and all who serve them. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us.

O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: Lourdes has a special place for the sick, who are treated as VIP pilgrims. This reflects Jesus' own preferential love for the suffering and illustrates the Church's commitment to caring for the ill as Christ did during His ministry.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Lourdes, bless all who are sick and all who care for them. Give courage to the suffering and strength to the caregivers.
days.scripture: "I was sick and you looked after me." - Matthew 25:36

days.title: Day 9: Trust and Thanksgiving
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Mother of Lourdes, as I conclude this novena, I come to you with trust and thanksgiving. Throughout these nine days, I have brought you my needs, my sorrows, my hopes, and my fears. I have prayed for healing, conversion, patience, and strength. Now I entrust all these intentions to your maternal care, confident that you will present them to your Son and that He will answer them according to His perfect wisdom and love. I thank you for all the blessings I have received throughout my life, many of which I have taken for granted. Thank you for moments of sudden healing that I did not even know to pray for. Thank you for times when you protected me from dangers I never knew existed. Thank you for conversions and reconciliations that seemed impossible. Thank you for strength in difficulties that I thought I could not bear. Thank you for your constant presence and intercession, even when I have neglected to call upon you. I promise to honor you as Our Lady of Lourdes throughout my life, to pray the rosary with devotion, to frequent the sacraments, and to share your message of penance and prayer with others. May the graces of this novena bear fruit in my life through greater faith, hope, and love. O Mother of Lourdes, I trust in your intercession and thank you for your motherly care. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us.

O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: The conclusion of this novena is an act of trust and gratitude. We entrust our petitions to Mary, confident that she will present them to her Son, and thank her for her constant intercession, knowing that every sincere prayer is heard and answered according to God's will.
days.intention_prayer: Our Lady of Lourdes, I entrust all my intentions to you with complete trust and thank you for your constant intercession before your Son Jesus.
days.scripture: "Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God." - Philippians 4:6

source: Traditional Catholic Novena to Our Lady of Lourdes
notes: This novena can be prayed at any time but is especially appropriate in preparation for the feast of Our Lady of Lourdes on February 11 or when seeking healing for any illness. It is also powerful when prayed for those preparing for surgery or medical treatment, for caregivers, and for conversion of sinners. Many pilgrims visit Lourdes each year to bathe in the miraculous waters, and those who cannot travel can still receive graces through prayer and spiritual communion with the shrine.
